publisherPolicy.result: Policy permits free-access playthrough/instruction videos and platform partner monetization of Valve content. It does not grant rights to someone else's recording/music. CC BY recording license is separately documented here. No sale/paywall or standalone asset redistribution.

game-master.viewingScope: Decoded contact sheets over the acquired ranges plus denser selected scene samples viewed directly by agent. Native files remain unmodified; no audio track was acquired.
game-master.audioExclusionReason: Video-only source; third-party soundtrack and voices not adopted.
game-master.observedBeforeActionResult: Hands lift and rotate vodka bottles; a large sideways bottle fills the frame in the denser 0–12s sample. Root correctly flagged that the liquid interface was not clear. Full-resolution frames at4.8s and6.5s show frosted/opaque glass, not an unmistakable liquid surface. This candidate does NOT yet support an opening claim that the viewer can see liquid staying level. The earlier contact-sheet judgment was too strong and is superseded.
game-master.claimLimits: The actual shader mechanism comes from Matt Wilde's original interview recorded in the research catalog. Do not infer its internal equations solely from gameplay. Confirm that the selected moving cut clearly exposes the liquid interface; use Unity for clean interface/volume visualization.

inspectedIntervalsOriginalSeconds.role: Opening: hand turns a large bottle from upright to sideways, glass interior and refraction visible.
Return to real bottle handling after Unity liquid-boundary explanation.
